name: size
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::size.int(Tensor self, int dim) -> int. This definition covers one overload only and is not exclusive. Original Gems pytest owns the full contract: it defines the overloads, keyword arguments, return forms, errors, aliasing and mutation, and tests must never be narrowed or reference behavior adapted to fit this one representative signature. Registered schemas supplied with this operator (verbatim): aten::size.int(Tensor self, int dim) -> int; aten::size.Dimname(Tensor self, str dim) -> int; aten::size(Tensor self) -> int[]. Behavior derived from the tests: every case compares flag_gems.size against the aten reference on the same operand, treating aten::size as a host-side metadata query that reports an operand's shape and reads no element; the dtype, value-range and special-value grids vary only the payload, and only the reported metadata is compared. The int form returns a Python int and the no-dim form returns a list of Python ints (both checked by isinstance, excluding bool). The compared operands include a transposed view, a column-strided slice, a nonzero-offset window, empty and 0-dim operands, and COO and CSR sparse operands, the only sparse layouts parametrized ([5, 6] for the COO case, [2, 3] for CSR), plus a zero-numel operand whose first extent exceeds 2**31. The reported metadata must come from the operand itself rather than its base. dim is exercised positionally and, in one case, by keyword. pytest asserts IndexError for an out-of-rank dim and for a 0-dim operand with dim, and RuntimeError/TypeError for a non-integer, string or None dim, so string dims appear there only as rejected arguments; the Dimname overload exists in the registered schema, but no supplied case exercises its positive named-tensor path. No supplied schema has a non-JSON default, so no rendered-default strings are retained.
